title: Add v2 hardening status log
acceptance: WHEN the repository opens THE SYSTEM SHALL contain docs/v2-admin-hardening-status.md with a task/status table.

title: Expose v2 admin menu links
acceptance: WHEN MainLayout renders for IssueAccess THE SYSTEM SHALL show links to single license, bulk licenses, products, and docs.
WHEN MainLayout renders for AdminUserAccess THE SYSTEM SHALL show SMTP and users links.

title: Add additive archive migration
acceptance: WHEN the migration is run twice THE SYSTEM SHALL keep software_products.is_archived present without duplicate-object failure.
WHEN verification SELECTs run THE SYSTEM SHALL report archived column present.

title: Implement product archive service
acceptance: WHEN ProductService archives a product THE SYSTEM SHALL set IsArchived true and write an AuditLogEntry with actor email.
WHEN products are listed for normal admin use THE SYSTEM SHALL exclude archived products by default.

title: Add product version service CRUD
acceptance: WHEN a version name is submitted for a product THE SYSTEM SHALL persist a ProductVersion linked to that product and write audit.
WHEN deleting a referenced ProductVersion THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse with a clear domain exception.

title: Update Products UI for versions
acceptance: WHEN admin opens Products THE SYSTEM SHALL show each product's version rows and an add-version control.
WHEN admin archives a product THE SYSTEM SHALL confirm the action and remove it from the normal table.

title: Harden single license issuance
acceptance: WHEN issuing for an existing product THE SYSTEM SHALL reject null or Guid.Empty VersionId before SaveChanges.
WHEN issuing a new product THE SYSTEM SHALL create a Default ProductVersion and assign license.VersionId to it.
WHEN issuing a key THE SYSTEM SHALL allow selecting Active or Test status.

title: Harden bulk license issuance
acceptance: WHEN bulk page is opened THE SYSTEM SHALL require product and ProductVersion before generation.
WHEN bulk keys are generated THE SYSTEM SHALL use the selected VersionId and selected Active/Test status for every key.

title: Implement test-license API bypass
acceptance: WHEN a Test license is activated THE SYSTEM SHALL approve activation without max-activation, review, or subscription blocks.
WHEN an Active license is activated THE SYSTEM SHALL preserve existing rule enforcement.

title: Add SMTP diagnostics
acceptance: WHEN test email fails THE SYSTEM SHALL show a sanitized failure reason in the UI.
WHEN test email fails THE SYSTEM SHALL log exception type, host, port, encryption, auth type, elapsed ms, and recipient domain without logging password.

title: Add email audit foundation
acceptance: WHEN a test or key email send is attempted THE SYSTEM SHALL record recipient, status, type, timestamp, and sanitized error if any.
WHEN email audit persists THE SYSTEM SHALL not store SMTP password or private key material.

title: Add admin docs portal
acceptance: WHEN admin opens Docs THE SYSTEM SHALL list integration docs and downloadable client artifacts.
WHEN a doc link is clicked THE SYSTEM SHALL return a static file from the admin app.

title: Update HelloWorld compatibility harness
acceptance: WHEN HelloWorld runs in new mode THE SYSTEM SHALL send VersionId in ActivateRequest.
WHEN HelloWorld runs in old-schema mode THE SYSTEM SHALL omit VersionId from the activation payload.

title: Add API compatibility tests
acceptance: WHEN compatibility tests run THE SYSTEM SHALL prove matching VersionId activates and mismatched VersionId returns InvalidKeyFormat.
WHEN compatibility tests run THE SYSTEM SHALL prove old-schema payload without VersionId still activates default-version license.

title: Finalize docs and gate
acceptance: WHEN final gate runs THE SYSTEM SHALL build and test successfully.
WHEN docs are reviewed THE SYSTEM SHALL describe menu modules, version management, test mode, SMTP diagnostics, docs portal, archive behavior, and compatibility testing.
